_about: Substance properties for the registry. molarMass kg/mol, cp J/(kg K) by phase, hhv J/kg, density kg/m3 by phase (at the condition in note), melting/boiling point C at 1 atm. null = no standard reference value found; never guessed. Atomic masses for the formula check: IUPAC CIAAW standard atomic weights https://ciaaw.org/atomic-weights.htm. Not carried over from the pirate table: smoke (soot and tars, no single substance) and the tagged-substance template.

rows.name: Water
rows.checked: Checked 2026-10-29 against the NIST WebBook page and its Mask=4 phase-change page: molecular weight 18.0153; row kept at 0.018 (engine rounding H=1, O=16) because 0.018015 breaks the exact element-mass conservation in test/reactions.test.ts (tolerance 5e-13) and the formula check; Tboil 373.17 K = 100.02 C match; Tfus is not listed there. cp and density are not on the cited pages: unverified
rows.note: density: ice 0 C, liquid 25 C, steam 100 C 1 atm; pirate id h2o_v is the gas phase of this row

rows.name: Saltpetre (potassium nitrate)
rows.checked: Checked 2026-10-30. The old source ID C7757795 is not a NIST page (not found); the KNO3 page is ID=C7757791, opened: name potassium nitrate, formula KNO3, CAS 7757-79-1, molecular weight 101.1032 (row 0.1011 matches). The page lists no phase-change data, no heat capacity and no enthalpy of formation (only a paid Web Thermo Tables link), so cp 953, density 2109, meltingPointC 334 and boilingPointC null are unverified
rows.note: decomposes near 400 C before boiling; cp from 96.4 J/(mol K)

rows.checked: Checked 2026-10-30. The JPCRD PDF (jpcrdS2Vol11.pdf) could not be opened (over the 10 MB fetch limit), so cp 818.16 (constant at 298.15 K) is unverified against it. The NIST WebBook calcium carbonate page (ID=C471341, titled 'Calcium carbonate (precipitated)') was opened: molecular weight 100.087 matches the row's 0.100078 at engine rounding. Its Mask=2 page gives no solid cp, no enthalpy of formation and no entropy (only a paid Web Thermo Tables link): cp and enthalpy of formation are unverified. The row carries no enthalpy-of-formation field
rows.note: Constant cp at 298.15 K [model]. Molar masses use the existing engine rounding H=1, C=12, O=16 g/mol and CIAAW Ca=40.078; this keeps seeded reaction masses additive.
